claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera
claims.evidence: Origin/usage history ('UK used') cannot be confirmed from photos; body and model match witness report.
No close-up of lens glass, sensor, or body wear shown; general photos only show shelf display.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 all show 'Canon EOS 600D' labeling on the body; no Sony branding visible anywhere.

risks.risk: Seller's stated brand (Sony) conflicts with the witness-identified brand (Canon) on the actual unit
risks.proof: A clear photo of the body nameplate and seller confirmation of which exact unit is for sale
risks.if_unproven: treat as unresolved identity mismatch, price at worst case until clarified

risks.risk: Shutter count / actual usage unknown despite 'UK used' claim
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data from a fresh test shot

risks.risk: Autofocus, sensor, and shutter function not verified
risks.proof: Short video clip of camera powering on, focusing, and firing shutter

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, haze) unknown for 18-55mm lens
risks.proof: Close-up photo of lens front and rear elements against light
risks.if_unproven: price as lens with possible optical defects

risks.risk: Unclear whether battery, charger, memory card, or other accessories are included
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: price as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Second body (700D) and Nikon lens cap suggest other items may be mixed into listing
risks.proof: Seller confirmation and photo clarifying exactly which items are included in this sale
risks.if_unproven: price only the single 600D body with 18-55mm lens as described

proof_requests: Clear photo of the body nameplate confirming brand (Canon vs Sony) to resolve the mismatch
Video of camera powering on, autofocus engaging, and shutter firing
Photo showing shutter count from camera menu or a test image's EXIF data
Close-up of lens elements (front and back) under light for scratches/fungus/haze
Photo of all accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap, box) included in the sale
Clarification on whether only the 600D+18-55mm lens is for sale, separate from the 700D and other visible gear
response.reason: The seller explicitly states the brand is Sony, but the witness report clearly and repeatedly identifies the body as a Canon EOS 600D with matching labeling, a direct contradiction that raises concern about listing accuracy or intent.
